## ✨ Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 🎯 Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? (e.g., "I'm frustrated when...")

## 💡 Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like. Be as specific as possible.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds?

## 📋 Use Case

How would you use this feature? What's your specific scenario?

## 🖥️ Platform

Which platform(s) does this feature apply to?

- [ ] Web SDK
- [ ] React Native SDK
- [ ] iOS native SDK
- [ ] Android native SDK
- [ ] Flutter SDK
- [ ] Backend API
- [ ] Admin UI
- [ ] Customer Portal
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other: _______________

## 🎨 Mockups / Examples

If applicable, add mockups, code examples, or diagrams.

```ts
// Example API
const result = await veriface.doNewThing()
```

## 📋 Additional Context

Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.

## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues to ensure this is not a duplicate
- [ ] I have described the problem clearly
- [ ] I have proposed a concrete solution
